title: Google Workspace Admin SDK & API Automation / Reporting Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Automate and report on Google Workspace with the Admin SDK and APIs
problem: Manual admin work and screenshot ‘reports’ don’t scale in a large Workspace tenant. This solution builds an Admin SDK & API automation/reporting toolkit: a secure service identity (OAuth / domain-wide delegation done right), authenticated Python against the Directory, Reports, Drive, and Groups APIs, reusable automation and reporting patterns (provisioning, license, sharing, and audit reports), and a scheduling model — so administration and evidence are automated, repeatable, and auditable.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the automation model: auth (OAuth / domain-wide delegation, least-scope), the key APIs (Directory/Reports/Drive/Groups), reusable patterns, and scheduling.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace super-admin, a project + service identity, least-privilege scopes, Python toolchain).

Implementation Guide — set up the service identity + least-scope auth, build authenticated API access, implement automation + reporting patterns, and schedule them — pilot-first; no keys in code (use a secured credential/ADC).

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (auth least-scope, reports accurate, automation idempotent) plus Best Practices for secure, maintainable Workspace automation.
short: Build a Google Workspace Admin SDK & API automation/reporting toolkit — secure least-scope auth, Python against Directory/Reports/Drive/Groups, reusable automation + reporting patterns, and scheduling — so administration and evidence are automated and auditable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
